text.about.10:
**Self-taught engineer, founder, salesman.**

I'm a forward deployed engineer at [TrustPixel](https://www.trustpixel.ai/), where I work alongside [Pratyush Tiwari](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pratyush-tiwari-0740734/) (co-founder of [MoneyLion](https://www.wsj.com/articles/financial-platform-moneylion-to-combine-with-spac-fusion-acquisition-11613166640), which went public in a $2.4B SPAC deal) and [Chris Ashley](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jcashley/).

My parents are immigrants who ran a Chinese American restaurant. I worked there through middle and high school, then graduated from Michigan's [Ross School of Business](https://www.google.com/search?q=what%27s+the+BBA+acceptance+rate+of+Michigan+Ross) at 22, in the top 15% ([magna cum laude](https://www.google.com/search?q=what+is+magna+cum+laude)) with a 3.9 GPA.

In college I interned on the investing side. First I was at [Renaissance Venture Capital](https://renvc.com/), a fund of funds, under [Chris Rizik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chris-rizik-674300/) and [Jeff Rinvelt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rinvelt/). Then I was at [Arboretum Ventures](https://www.arboretumvc.com/), a $1B+ healthcare fund, reporting to [Paul McCreadie](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paulmccreadie/) and [Tom Shehab](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thomasshehab/). One company I did diligence on there was [Motif Neurotech](https://motifneuro.tech/), which went on to implant its depression treatment in its first human patients ([Bloomberg covered it](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-09-13/depression-treatment-startup-says-implants-placed-in-two-human-skulls)). Paul is the reason I got into startups.

I co-founded Pink Inference with [Jonah Weinbaum](https://www.linkedin.com/in/weinbaumjonah/), an [Emergent Ventures](https://www.mercatus.org/emergent-ventures) fellow, to work on wetware computing. We were backed by a $100K pre-seed from [1517 Fund](https://www.1517fund.com/).

After that I built Project GEO on my own. It tracks how often ChatGPT and Claude bring up a brand when people ask them questions. I took it from nothing to its first paying customer. My writing on GEO made the Hacker News front page.

In 2025 I co-founded [Aventos](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfzG7qaPV5p_QE1sr1mcXaA), an AI anime studio in San Francisco. We acquired the anime rights to [My Cat Is a Vegetarian](https://page.kakao.com/content/58076879/), a Korean series with 98.5M views.

I'm looking for collaborators and people to hire. If you're building something ambitious, email me.
text.about.28: AI anime studio. We were taking popular Korean Intellectual Property and turning them into anime using AI. I owned the full stack of building it: acquiring IP, directing, editing, coding our internal tools, marketing our show and negotiating IP deals with Korean publishers. Landed a publisher deal that's has 98.5M views in Korea, a distribution deal with BlueBox.tv, and turned our internal tooling into a platform with its first $10K in revenue.
text.about.31: AEO/LLM citation tracker which tracks how well a brand shows up when people ask ChatGPT or Claude AI questions about brand discoverability. Built the full tech stack solo and took it 0 to 1 in B2B SaaS sales.
